recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is indicated for FHIR-20494 unless the work group later revises the broader workflow extension guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-20494 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. The final OO decision changed the original broadening request into removal of Task.instantiatesCanonical and Task.instantiatesURI from Task, with implementer guidance to use workflow-triggeredBy, workflow-generatedFrom, workflow-compliesWith, and workflow-shallComplyWith instead.
initial_application: Commit ba7bffc2b5 removed the Task.instantiatesCanonical and Task.instantiatesUri element definitions and mappings from source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml and added the replacement-extension note in source/task/task-introduction.xml. Current Task search parameters do not include these elements. The application missed a commented-out instantiatesCanonical line in source/task/task-cpg-example-1.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Task as a resource and source/task/list-Task-examples.xml lists Task/cpg-example-1, so the edited example is in current build scope. FHIR-19690 is a duplicate of the same Task.instantiates concern. The 2025-06-03 OO minutes record the 4-0-1 disposition to remove the elements and use workflow extensions. The workflow extension canonicals are present in current source/extension evidence.
reconciliation: Removed the stale commented-out instantiatesCanonical element from source/task/task-cpg-example-1.xml. No further Task StructureDefinition or narrative edits were needed because those source locations already match the final issue resolution.
source_changes: Removed the commented-out <instantiatesCanonical> line from source/task/task-cpg-example-1.xml, which is listed as Task/cpg-example-1 in the active Task examples.
